s1.explanation: Responds to a single dog's head and face seen large and close-up, especially one looking toward the camera. It is strongest for light-colored (white, cream, tan) fluffy or soft fur on the face, as in the Maltese, yellow Labrador, corgi and dingo photos. Activity drops when the dog is small in the frame, seen whole-body at a distance, partly hidden, or shown with other dogs. Compared with the similar units, this unit favors pale or tan soft-coated faces and close head shots. It responds less to dark, wiry or wolf-like and German-shepherd-like faces.
